status_note: The covered projection compares twelve isolated applyOp cases plus the complete 72-value live typed opcode list and one production ActionPool dispatch pass. It covers all six guards in source order, the writemask/autolive 2x2 matrix, strict pass > deadcodedelay boundaries, deadremoved's allowed-only side effect, doesDeadcode=false bypass, and full visible op/block/bank/output/def-use mutation. Overall remains MISMATCH: Ghidra Rule::getOpList also registers raw buckets 0 and 45, and a destroyed C++ PcodeOp retains nullable input arity while Rugra clears its Vec. Full manager-indexed Heritage state, late-generation warning/restart behavior, and real Architecture space inventory on the Rust side remain UNTESTED/MISMATCH.

rugra_source.overlay_note: The runner archives the fixed base then overlays exactly the four hash-pinned production files under test; src/varnode.rs is required to observe the separated writemask/addlflags state.

analysis_options.rule: Production RuleEarlyRemoval, direct applyOp for isolated guard cases and one production ActionPool with flags=0 for exactly one typed-dispatch pass.
analysis_options.heritage: Each isolated Funcdata starts with an instrumented, read-observable Ghidra Heritage infolist, an explicit pass, and a public Funcdata::setDeadCodeDelay call. Rust uses its production HeritageInfo projection. The instrumentation only exposes buildInfoList/pass/deadremoved and does not alter applyOp or deadRemovalAllowedSeen.
analysis_options.ir: Fresh Funcdata and one BlockBasic per case. Every target op is inserted through Funcdata APIs. Inputs are distinct constants; outputs are unique unless the doesDeadcode=false OTHER-space case says otherwise. The descendant guard adds one live COPY reader.
analysis_options.dispatch: The typed corpus constructs numeric opcodes 1..73 excluding unused raw 45, each with zero inputs and one unused unique output. Production ActionPool dispatch is single-pass; CALL/CALLIND/CALLOTHER/NEW survive guard 1 and the other 68 ops are destroyed.
analysis_options.normalization: Only records beginning residual= are excluded from the covered diff. No covered value, order, boolean, status, counter, list membership, or mutation field is normalized.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and iteration are deterministic

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({architecture,compiler_spec,analysis_options,binary,functions,cases}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

observation_schema.format: Seventeen fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline; fourteen covered lines and three residual lines.
observation_schema.guards: Each case records result, pass/delay, all preceding guard predicates, deadremoved, alive/dead lists, block membership, output-bank/attachment state, and input descendant transition.
observation_schema.dispatch: Exact numeric typed list/order/count and production ActionPool perform/status/Rule tests/applies/alive opcodes/dead count/deadremoved.
observation_schema.residuals: Raw Rule::getOpList buckets, destroyed-op nullable input arity, and full Heritage manager closure remain in stdout and force raw overall MISMATCH.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: applyOp mutates the passed Funcdata and PcodeOp by identity. On success opDestroy deletes the exact output, unlinks every input descendant, removes the op from its exact BlockBasic/alive list, and puts it on the dead list. deadRemovalAllowedSeen mutates the exact per-space HeritageInfo only when allowed.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: The locked source order is call, indirect-source, output, descendants, autolive, then the space/Heritage gate. The dynamic cases isolate every guard and prove each of the first five suppresses the later manager side effect; relative ordering among those otherwise-pure early returns is source-audited rather than dynamically distinguishable. Rule::getOpList iterates raw i=0 while i<CPUI_MAX(74); the covered typed projection preserves numeric order 1..73 and skips only raw 45. ActionPool traverses the 72 SeqNum-ordered live ops once.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: Each isolated manager begins deadremoved=0. pass and deadcodedelay are per case; allowed is strict pass>delay and sets deadremoved=1 exactly before opDestroy. Single-pass dispatch starts Rule counters at zero and accumulates 72 tests/68 applies.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: Dispatch keys are numeric opcode values. Op/block/bank checks use pointer identity; no pointer value is printed or sorted. Case and operation order are construction/SeqNum order with no unordered normalization.

six_guard_sequence.covers: The outcomes of isCall, isIndirectSource, null output, nonempty descendants, isAutoLive, and doesDeadcode/deadRemovalAllowedSeen, including suppression of the manager side effect by each of the first five guards. Pure-guard relative ordering is not claimed as a separately distinguishable runtime observation.

writemask_autolive_orthogonality.covers: All four write-mask/autolive combinations. writemask alone does not keep an op alive; either autolive combination does.

pass_delay_seen_and_space.covers: 0>0 false, 1>1 false, 1>0 true, 2>1 true; allowed-only deadremoved mutation; and OTHER doesDeadcode=false bypass without a seen mutation.

typed_dispatch.covers: All 72 Rust-representable live opcodes in numeric order and one production ActionPool pass with 72 tests, 68 destroys, CALL/CALLIND/CALLOTHER/NEW survivors.

raw_opcode_buckets.covers: Ghidra's inherited Rule::getOpList registers raw bucket 0 and unused bucket 45; Rust OpCode cannot represent either key.

nullable_input_arity.covers: After opDestroy Ghidra preserves numInput=1 with slot0 NULL; Rugra clears the input Vec to arity zero.

full_heritage_and_architecture_manager.covers: Manager-index identity, absent/malformed spaces, reset/restart, bumpDeadcodeDelay and late-generation warnings, full BFD space flags on Rust, exceptional delay settings, and concurrent manager state are outside this fixture.

build.ghidra: Archive locked e40ed130 decompiler C++ tree, add hash-pinned fixture-only Heritage/Funcdata accessors, rebuild libdecomp.a, and link the fixture with pinned BFD 2.38.
build.rugra: Archive fixed base 7e91aef, overlay exactly src/ruleaction.rs, src/heritage.rs, src/space.rs and the load-bearing src/varnode.rs writemask/autolive separation, build offline/locked, then compile the Rust fixture against that library.
build.cargo_lock: Runner serializes only Cargo target mutation with /tmp/rugra-cargo-build.lock and uses the repository default target cache as directed by the main writer.
